svg.title: Vishwas Aithal | After Hours Cybercafe
svg.desc: A handmade after-hours computer shop scene: textured beige CRT with green DOS boot and original pixel game, Winamp-era equalizer, keyboard and floppy, beside a bold Vishwas Aithal title, period boot tape and modern development status. The header opens an interactive retro website.
svg.text: THE KID WHO CLICKED EVERY ICON
PLAYLIST: WINDOWS 95 / WINAMP / SNAKE / BLOGGER / PYTHON / SECURITY
